title: Sprint Pulse: runtime quick-brief (personal prep)
content:
Context:
- Quick personal prep for weekly runtime sync. I want this to be an ultra-compact pulse: what moved this sprint, what we need to unblock, and 3 focus items for the week after. Keep phrasing short — will read aloud.

Objectives for sync (3):
1) Confirm rollout plan for KV-cache lite experiment and whether we can widen to 3 more endpoints.
2) Align on perf budget for 4096->8192 seq path — do we accept 15% cost bump for 25% latency win?
3) Get sign-off on fallback routing change: prefer cheaper-variant first for non-SLO requests.

Snapshot metrics (last 72h, eyeballed):
- p50 gen latency: 38ms (stable)
- p95 gen latency: 210ms -> spike on tuesday 03:00 (region-eu); suspected partial node oom/restart
- KV-cache hit rate (pilot endpoints): 44% -> initial uplift in tokens/saved but tail inconsistent
- GPU utilization pool-A: 72% (steady), pool-B: 88% (bursty)
- Cost/unit: +8% week-over-week (artifact of more 8192-seq runs)

Agenda (30m total):
1) 00:00-00:04 Quick pulse: one-line wins & blips (everyone)
2) 00:04-00:12 KV-cache lite experiment review (Evelyn)
   - short demo, hit-rate breakdown, weird tails, immediate next steps
3) 00:12-00:20 8192-seq rollout discussion (Marcus)
   - perf tradeoffs, knob for model-variant auto-select, cost guardrails
4) 00:20-00:26 Fallback routing proposal (Samir)
   - policy sketch, safety guard (SLO tag), rollout canary plan
5) 00:26-00:30 Quick actions & owners (Rita)

Prep notes / things to flag verbally:
- KV-cache: observed regressions on short seqs — hypothesis: eviction policy not favoring short-prefix reuse. Need to check cache key normalization.
- 8192 path: our quantized kernels are hitting a kernel scheduling bottleneck on Ampere gen-2; Marcus to share perf flamegraph.
- Region-eu spike: SRE said kubelet restart on 3 nodes; may want to correlate with autoscaler bump. I queued the logs (see linked artifact).
- Cost: we can try short-term trick: route cold-starty requests to a cheaper-variant (higher latency but less tokens), measure user-perceived impact.

Micro experiments to propose (quick, 48–72h):
- E1: KV-cache eviction knob: bias for prefix-length <= 64 tokens for 24h on pilot endpoints. Metric: hit-rate, p95 latency delta. Owner: Evelyn.
- E2: Kernel-thread pinning on pool-B for 6h window. Metric: variance in p95 tail. Owner: Marcus.
- E3: Fallback-route cheap-variant A/B: send 5% traffic (non-SLO tag) and capture user-error/quality metric. Owner: Samir.

Blockers (things I need help with):
- Need a tracing hook to mark requests that used cached KV so we can query obs quickly (low priority but helpful). Who can add trace tag? (ask: infra-observability?)
- Cluster autoscaler config for pool-B is currently opaque; need rights to inspect helm values (ping infra).
- Kernel perf graphs — Marcus, please annotate hotspots before the sync (link to PR above).

Quick action-items (to read at end):
- Evelyn: flip KV eviction bias on pilot endpoints; monitor 24h report -> due 2026-03-14.
- Marcus: produce annotated flamegraph + suggested mitigation (thread pinning or batch-size cap) -> due 2026-03-13 EOD.
- Samir: draft fallback-route canary plan (including SLO scope & rollback condition) -> due 2026-03-15.
- Rita (me): open a small incident ticket to track region-eu kubelet restarts and link to autoscaler change -> created RW-4213 (follow-up to assign to SRE) -> due 2026-03-13.
- Team: quick review of cost impact table I will paste in Slack after sync (ask for comments by 2026-03-16).

Notes-to-self (bullet rough):
- Keep sync short. If any topic expands, spin up 15m follow-on with only relevant people.
- Remember to ask Evelyn whether eviction change has downstream effect on cold-start memory.
- If Marcus recommends batch-size cap, check effect on throughput SLA with Customer Success templates.
- If Samir's policy touches routing, add a QA step in sandbox (no live traffic) before canary.

Loose questions I want answered by EOD (pre-read helps):
- Can we get a simple chart: KV hit-rate vs p95 per-endpoint for last 7 days? (Evelyn)
- What exact autoscaler events coincided with region-eu kubelet crashes? timeline? (SRE)
- Is the cost bump due to token length distribution shift or more concurrency? (FinOps -> quick ask)

Post-sync follow-ups (my plan):
- Capture final action list and paste into sprint board; mark owners & due dates.
- If fallbacks approved, add a small metric dashboard (p90/p95 cost vs latency) for the first 72h.
- Schedule a 30-min deep-dive next week on kernel tuning if Marcus needs more time.

Rough talking script (first 60s):
- "Two quick highlights: KV-cache pilot shows promising token savings but weird tails; second, 8192-seq gives good p50 gains but at a measurable cost — want to decide guardrails today. Rest are blockers we can spin follow-ups on"

Scratch: raw links / snippets I might paste in the meeting chat:
- perf PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-runtime/pull/876
- incident/trace: https://console.redwood/proj/trace/trace-20260310
- linear ticket placeholder: RW-4213

End of doc — keep this as my personal prep. After sync: convert action-items to sprint board card titles and move to "in progress" where applicable.
